kind: BDI historical-source applicability and retained-contact follow-up

full_families: gb:BDI:ADM2 (119 features; represented-year claim 2007; Public Domain)

retained_evidence_read.note: Retained full-target physical support includes whole-target adverse cases; do not treat the center-intersection result as repair qualification.

retained_point_join_findings.source_and_physical_result: The independent 583-center comparison against all 193 features in the four queue-named complete source families reports 583 direct expected-target hits, 0 stored-source-roster mismatches, 583 physical expected-class hits, 0 original centers intersecting an adverse physical-issue geometry, and 54 source-contact rows from foreign ADM1 candidates (51 TZA, 3 COD).
retained_point_join_findings.source_contact_ownership: Of 33 exact contacted features, 21 are directly owner-mapped BDI ADM2 features with matching reverse lineage; 9 BDI ADM1 contacts have empty direct-owner and reverse-owner vectors because they are parent-level context; 1 COD ADM1 and 2 TZA ADM1 contacts are ownerless foreign context. These parent/foreign overlaps are retained, not credited as direct owners or dismissed as non-candidates.
retained_point_join_findings.water: All 205 inland-water keys remain in the package and are not reclassified by the physical-center hit result. Existing block masks support the recorded land/water labels, but cannot substitute for current physical/source qualification.

official_primary_sources_examined.title: Organic Law No. 1/05 of 16 March 2023 on determining and delimiting provinces, communes, zones, hills/neighborhoods
official_primary_sources_examined.finding: This is the enacted boundary-setting law, not merely a proposal. Search-indexed annex text identifies the new Bujumbura commune list including Muhuta and places Bugarama in the annex's zone-name list. The PDF extraction/screenshot route returned no readable page text (Assembly PDF 0 text lines; CENI returned Cloudflare verification), so I did not independently read or certify the annex's exact heading/old-to-new boundaries from the image.
official_primary_sources_examined.limit: It establishes the current legal subdivision framework; it does not itself establish that a particular 2007 polygon is boundary-equivalent to a present legal unit or where each original cell falls relative to any revised boundary.

official_primary_sources_examined.title: 2022 Senate-hosted draft organic law and explanatory text
official_primary_sources_examined.finding: The indexed draft expressly says the proposed new Muhuta commune would consist of the old Bugarama and Muhuta communes. This is positive historical-to-proposed composition evidence, but the document is a draft, not proof that all 2007 feature boundaries were unchanged in the enacted law.

official_primary_sources_examined.title: INSBU Annuaire Statistique du Burundi, édition 2024 (RGPHAE 2024 results)
official_primary_sources_examined.finding: Tables 1.04–1.05 (PDF pages 25–26; extracted lines 854–958) present the 2024 census results under the post-reform five-province/42-commune frame. The current Bujumbura table contains Muhuta and Ntahangwa; Buhumuza contains Gisagara and Muyinga; Burunga contains Rumonge and Nyanza. Several old names therefore persist in current statistical nomenclature, while many other old contacts are absent from the top-level current commune list. The tables are administrative statistics, not boundary polygons or a cellwise crosswalk.

official_primary_sources_examined.title: Presidency of Burundi, Council of Ministers communiqué, 15 June 2022
official_primary_sources_examined.finding: The official communiqué describes the reorganization proposal, the history/criteria, and annexes the proposed 42-commune list. It is prior to enactment and is useful for proposal context only.

official_primary_sources_examined.title: Presidency of Burundi, Council of Ministers communiqué, 18 September 2025
official_primary_sources_examined.finding: The communiqué treats the reorganization as implemented in 2025 and describes institutions adjusted to the new province/commune structure. This confirms contemporary administrative operation, not a geospatial crosswalk.

positive_evidence: The four pinned historical source-family bodies are complete and their exact property identities, owner vectors, terms, and represented-year metadata were joined to the original contact indices.

Official source evidence shows continuity of multiple names into the current census frame; the Senate draft gives a specific Bugarama+Muhuta-to-Muhuta transition, while the enacted law and 2024 census place Muhuta in the current Bujumbura structure.

583 original centers match their recorded BDI ADM2 source feature, and all 583 land/water classes match retained physical expected-class coverage, with no center in any retained adverse physical issue geometry.
not_established: The complete old-119-to-current-42 legal unit crosswalk for all 21 BDI ADM2 owner features; exact applicable zone membership for each source; or whether source/candidate geometries preserve all post-reform boundary definitions.
Whole-target physical issues remain on 9 targets, even though no original center intersects the adverse geometries. The full-target issues have not been cleared.
The official law annex could not be extracted/rendered by the browser PDF reader; do not state its detailed Bugarama/Muhuta annex assignment based solely on search snippets.

Historical licence labels/represented years are source-catalogue facts, not current rights/applicability clearance. The BDI ADM2 Public Domain label and 2007 vintage do not prove current source authority or geometry equivalence.
applicability_assessment.next_witness_to_seek: A machine-readable official/INSBU/CENI current commune-zone boundary layer or an authenticated law-appendix table linking current legal zones to the old 119 commune roster, followed by an exact source-membership comparison limited to the 583 keys and their 21 target IDs. If no such official crosswalk exists, a bounded documented lineage from old commune to current zone may be sufficient where exact legal membership is demonstrable; do not demand a generic modern certificate or replace the 2007 source solely by date.
scope_limits: This research did not run another selected-owner observer, replay the physical producer, or compute geometry.
It did not contact agencies, alter claims, publish candidate data, or change root credit.
The 2022 draft is not treated as enacted law; current statistical names are not treated as proof of identical boundaries.
Physical and source geometries were already incidentally parsed by earlier retained evidence work; no new geometry analysis was performed in this official-document investigation.
